reasons.auth: Klaviyo provides private API key authentication (Authorization: Klaviyo-API-Key) and requires OAuth for published partners (Authorization: Bearer).
reasons.access: Developers can sign up and obtain credentials for free; the free plan is available for all accounts.
reasons.mcp: The Klaviyo MCP server is documented and published by Klaviyo itself.
reasons.verdict: Public REST API, free self‑serve credentials, and official MCP support allow a toolkit to be built immediately.
